notes:
Fix repeated Claude sign-in requests in Claw Bot.

DroidFun App 0.10.9 lets installed Claude Code renew an expired session on a normal installation, uses startup options compatible with older and current clients, and refreshes the connection status shown in account settings. It sends no model prompt and preserves saved screens, droid profiles and firmware. A revoked or unrefreshable Claude login can still require sign-in.

Windows x64, Windows ARM64 and Linux installers are included. The public Mac installer remains at 0.10.0 while Apple Developer ID signing and notarization credentials are unavailable; no Mac update is advertised by this release. Windows versions before 0.10.8 need one manual installation from droidfun.io to use the independent Windows update channel.

Validation details are recorded with the native package artifacts. Expiry/recovery checks use isolated fixture credentials; a new natural live-account expiry was not observed.
